title: Cybersecurity Firm Cathedral Reportedly Used AI Agents to Access Anthropic's Internal Business Systems
summary: Cybersecurity firm Cathedral reportedly used AI agents to exploit third-party software and access internal systems at AI developer Anthropic during invited security testing. Cathedral reported routes to personnel data and internal messages. Anthropic confirmed limited access to business systems holding contact details and basic account records, blocked access, and said Cathedral had not fully followed testing rules.
